notes.integration: Runtime draws every label, scenario title, round number and icon. The supplied mockup deliberately contains no battlefield; the live board remains beneath the runtime dimmer.
notes.style: Flat matte slate #2C3A55, one shadow tone #1D273A, even dark outline #2B2A33 and thin solid gold #D8A93A. No gradients, bevels, glow or generated icons.
notes.reuse: panel.png and all three equally sized button states are shared with settings. Existing SVG icons are referenced by the game and are not copied or changed.
